ValidationRule.description: Cannot skip opportunity stages. Applies to Agency opportunities.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(StageName) && (CASE( StageName , "Introduction",1, "Needs Analysis",2, "Benefits Presentation",3, "Quote",4, "Negotiation",5, "Closed Won",6, "Closed Lost",6,0)-1 <> CASE(PRIORVALUE(StageName) , "Introduction",1, "Needs Analysis",2, "Benefits Presentation",3, "Quote",4, "Negotiation",5, "Closed Won",6, "Closed Lost",6,0)) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Pipeline")) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")) && RecordTypeId ="0121a000000EqqS"
